directly_viewed_official_images.observed: Irregular rough rock ceiling arch over constructed supports, localized warm light and receding shadows.
Tall continuous rock cavern, uneven rock ledges, dark cool surrounding mass.

adaptations: Continuous connected wall/ceiling shell replaces dominant rectangular planes and separate repeated oval boulders.
Neutral dark gray-brown matte rock uses existing project GroundRock color through three-axis world projection.
Preserve Q warm/Z cool identity and test with unchanged lights first; local adjustment only if actual render requires it.
material_risks: Old ColorTint affects original top branch; the old side triplanar branch uses hardcoded .75/.72/.65, so MI ColorTint alone does not darken all rock.
Old XY Normal is unsuitable as an unverified normal projection for the new curved shell; new parent uses neutral tangent normal.
Large calm wall planes remain a visual risk even when topology and routes pass.

actual_source_only_preview_review.initial_observation: Continuous arch silhouette improves continuity, but initial room wall remains broadly rectangular and calm; regular smooth tunnel bands need stronger large-scale rock shape.

artifact_retention: Reference links and hashes only; no duplicate before pictures or whole raw report batches copied.
